comments.author: Priya Sharma
comments.body: Accept list includes image/heic from the mobile upload path; sharp build in the image worker was compiled without HEIF support.

content.text: Accept list includes image/heic from the mobile upload path; sharp build in the image worker was compiled without HEIF support.

Profile avatar upload accepts .heic / .heif (file picker and drag-drop), returns 201, and shows a progress complete state. The served avatar URL then returns a 1x1 broken placeholder PNG instead of a converted image.

Either reject HEIC client-side with a clear message, or transcode to JPEG/WebP on upload and serve that. Today we accept the file, store the original bytes, and the image pipeline fails conversion without failing the upload.
Workers log heic decode not available in this runtime then write the placeholder. Users on iPhone cameras think their photo is set until everyone else sees the broken icon.
